_desc: Translator — module card (Admin panel → Modules, translator icon in the page menu): languages, translation editor.
title: Languages
intro: English is the base language — built in and fixed. Every other language is a translation: texts without a translation show in English.
choose_note: You choose the page language in General settings.
disabled: The “Translator” module is off. Turn it on in General settings.
load_failed: The “Translator” module could not be loaded.
editor_intro: English text on the left, translation on the right. Leave a field empty and the text shipped with the page (or English) shows there. Words in curly brackets, e.g. {time}, are values filled in by the page — keep them in the translation.
no_editable: There is no translation to edit yet.
confirm_discard: Unsaved changes will be lost. Continue?
saved_current: Translations saved: {n}. Refresh the page to see them on the page and in the Admin panel.
created: Language {name} ({code}) created. Translate in the editor below.
delete_confirm: Delete the translation {name} ({code})? The file goes to the folder config/langs/deleted — it can be recovered.
delete_changes_confirm: Delete your changes to the translation {name} ({code})? The translation shipped with the page comes back. The file with your changes goes to the folder config/langs/deleted.
deleted_changes: Your changes to the translation {name} deleted.
upload_not_json: This is not a JSON file.
upload_no_code: The file has no language code: in “_meta” set “code” (e.g. "de") and “name” (e.g. "Deutsch").
upload_replace: The file will replace your translation {name} ({code}). The previous version goes to the folder config/langs/deleted. Upload?
uploaded: Translation {code} uploaded: {imported} texts. Not translated (same as English): {untranslated}, unknown skipped: {skipped}.
outside_title: Translating outside the page (e.g. in a text editor)
outside_1: Download the English template (en.json with all texts and place descriptions).
outside_2: Translate the texts to the right of the colon. Do not change the names on the left or values in curly brackets, e.g. {time}.
outside_3: At the top of the file, in “_meta”, set the language code and name, e.g. "code": "de", "name": "Deutsch". Save as de.json (UTF-8 encoding).
outside_4: Upload the language file. Plural forms of your language (e.g. Polish _few, _many) can be filled in later in the editor.
